description: This is a test source file containing unit tests for the GatewaySession functionality in the ai.openclaw.app.gateway package. It includes tests for URL building, timeout resolution, and URL rewriting related to gateway sessions.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTimeoutTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of gateway session functions such as URL formatting, timeout resolution, and URL rewriting.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthority_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests the formatting of IPv6 host with brackets and port.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests constructing WebSocket URLs with IPv6 hosts, with and without TLS.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_normalizesPersistedBracketedIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests normalization of IPv6 addresses in URL construction.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesFloorWhenMissingOrTooSmall

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesInvokeBudgetWithinBounds
methods.description: Tests the timeout resolution function with typical values within bounds.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_capsAtUpperBound
methods.description: Ensures timeout does not exceed maximum bound.
